verdict.rationale: Rev AI's own marketing says it goes 'beyond transcription' with sentiment analysis, topic extraction, summarization, and language identification. These are AI-generated insights drawn from the user's audio data, but the pack has only a single homepage mention. Nothing shows how these insights are surfaced or used, and the docs pages on features cover only transcription formatting options. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the insight features (sentiment, topics, summarization), any in-product or dashboard surfacing of insights, AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
